reason: Hypothesis: int4-g128 is the safest candidate to retain at least 95% BF16 extraction quality and throughput. In the measured first block, both int4 trials scored quality 1.0 and throughput above 16.3, while int3-g128 and mixed3-4-g128 fell below the 0.95 quality target. Its measured peak memory was about 2,299 MiB, higher than the tested lower-bit options, so it may not minimize memory. No heldout tasks were measured; this recommendation needs falsification on heldout tasks and repeated throughput checks against BF16.
risk: The evidence does not show whether int4-g128 meets the 95% throughput-retention gate because BF16 throughput is not supplied, and there are no heldout results. It also leaves open whether a lower-memory recipe can meet both gates.
